errorContains: Request "search_controls" at page "home" uses "$lookup" on collection "catalogue" over tenant connection "org_scope". Collection "catalogue" belongs to connection "frameworks", which is declared tenant: shared, so it carries no tenant field. The wall prepends a tenant $match into every $lookup/$unionWith sub-pipeline, so this stage will match nothing and the join returns []. Run the pipeline on "frameworks" and pass the organization facts in through the request payload, or declare tenant: authored on this request and author the organization clause yourself.
